description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveRequestCommentDao class, which manages database operations related to leave request comments within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It includes methods for searching, counting, saving, and retrieving leave request comments and related entities, utilizing Doctrine ORM for query building and pagination.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing leave request comments, providing search, save, and retrieval operations leveraging Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveRequestCommentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave request comments matching the search filter.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveRequestCommentPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object for leave request comments based on filter parameters.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Persists a LeaveRequestComment entity to the database.
